verdict.rationale: The private-networking half is supported: each CKS cluster runs in its own private VPC, and VPC networking can be managed through Terraform and API access tokens. Nothing in the evidence shows how to expose ports or publicly serve applications from nodes or instances. missing for 10: documentation of port exposure, load balancers or ingress for serving apps; detail on instance-to-instance private connectivity within or across VPCs; independent or hands-on corroboration.
